resources.string: Sikker på, at %1$s apps skal afinstalleres?
Canta places a small helper in /data/local/tmp on the device to read and manage apps. It runs only while Canta uses it.
This device runs an Android version older than 9, which Canta doesn\'t support.
Couldn\'t set up Canta\'s helper on the device. Check that it is connected and authorized, then try again.
Failed to reach the device. Check that it is connected and authorized.

Canta is an open source uninstaller app that uses Shizuku to remove system and user apps.
It allows you to debloat your device as you wish, no PC required.

Special thanks to %1$s.
Canta would't be the same without their work.
Hent automatisk en ny version af app bloat info. Dette garanterer opdaterede badges og app-beskrivelser.

Denne app leverer app-fjernelsesanbefalinger baseret på tredjepartsoplysninger. Disse anbefalinger er informative af natur og garanterer ikke sikkerhed eller kompatibilitet med nogen specifik enhed. Afinstallering af system-apps kan forårsage uventede problemer, herunder, men ikke begrænset til: Mistet funktionalitet, systemustabilitet, enheds-bootloops, datatab mv. App-udvikleren er ikke ansvarlig for evt. skader forårsaget på nogen enhed som konsekvens af at følge de givne anbefalinger.
Ved at klikke på \"Fortsæt\", accepterer man at bruge denne app på egen risiko.
Om dialogen til bekræftelse af afinstallationshandlingen skal vises.
Tryk %1$d gange mere for at aktivere valg af alle funktioner.
Vælg alle er slået til for filtertypen \"Anbefalet\".
Importér et forvalg fra udklipsholderen, eller indsæt JSON-tekst direkte.
Importér forvalg fra udklipsholder. Sørg for, at der er kopieret en gyldig Canta forvalgs-JSON.
Change the name and description of this preset.
Opret et forvalg fra aktuelt afinstallerede apps. Dette vil gemme en liste over apps, som kan deles og anvendes på andre enheder.
Opret eller importér forvalg for at håndtere app-afinstalleringslister på tværs af enheder
Canta bruger Shizuku til at afinstallere apps uden at kræve root-adgang. Shizuku giver en sikker måde at få adgang til systemniveau-SDK\'er.
Hvorfra man får commit-info til opdateringer fra
Hvorfra man får badges og beskrivelser.
Hvorvidt apps markeret som usikre må vælges (anvendelse af forvalg omgår allerede dette).
Synes om Canta? Den er bygget i min fritid med fortrolighed i tankerne - ingen annoncer eller sporing. Finder du den nyttig, overvej venligst at støtte dens udvikling!
Kræv godkendelse for at afinstallere/geninstallere apps.
Choose which Android device Canta should manage. Enable USB debugging on the device and authorize this computer when prompted.
No devices found. Check the connection and try again.
Connect your Android device over USB, then pick it in the browser prompt. Enable USB debugging on the device and accept the authorization prompt on its screen.
This browser cannot access USB devices. Open Canta in Chrome or Edge on a computer to connect your phone.
Access to the USB device was denied. Unplug it and plug it back in, grant access again with \"Pick device\", and make sure no other program (such as adb) is using the device.

Access to the USB device was denied. On Linux, browsers need permission to open USB devices: install udev rules for your phone (e.g. the android-udev-rules package), then unplug it and plug it back in.
Access to the USB device was denied. On Windows, the phone\'s ADB interface needs a WinUSB driver: install it with Zadig, then unplug the phone and plug it back in.
Could not connect to the device: %1$s
The selected device is no longer available. Please pick it again.
The device is already in use by another program or browser tab. Close anything else using it, unplug the device and plug it back in, then pick it again.

The device is busy: another program on this computer has claimed it. On Linux this is often ModemManager, an adb server, or a file-transfer (MTP) monitor. Stop them (e.g. sudo systemctl stop ModemManager), unplug the phone and plug it back in, then pick it again.
